brief: Clear the intake louvres on the north wall partially blocked by wind-blown debris and remove the stacked pallets left inside the compound obstructing the ventilation grilles [SOP-011]. Since this ageing unit cannot be attended to correct the cooling reduction before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
